project_promise.player_fantasy: Describe what the player emotionally gets to be or do.
project_promise.primary_experience: Hybrid interactive visual story: text+image setup, video for key turns, meaningful choices.
non_goals: Do not generate assets that the runtime will not display.
Do not make the story understandable only through video motion.

story_intention.protagonist_identity: Describe the player/protagonist identity in dramatic terms.
story_intention.core_goal: Describe what the protagonist actively tries to accomplish.
story_intention.core_conflict: Describe the main opposing pressure, dilemma, flaw, relationship, or world force.
story_intention.core_question: State the question the whole story tests through scenes and choices.
story_intention.emotional_anchor: State the feeling the player should retain after finishing.
story_intention.core_intention: State what the story finally discovers, embodies, or argues.
story_intention.gameplay_expression: Describe how choices, values, gates, failures, or route locks express the intention.
story_intention.choice_pressure: Describe what kind of hesitation the player should feel when choosing.

character_intention_roles.role_in_intention: The decision center who must face the core conflict.
character_intention_roles.route_question: What does this character's route or presence ask?
character_intention_roles.emotional_function: What emotion this character brings into the story.

must_not_become: A list of events without a clear dramatic question.

scope: local expansion from approved story graph

global_constraints.rule: The player protagonist is first-person and should not appear as a visible male character unless explicitly approved.

gate_plan.name: Coherence Plan
acceptance: Disciplines, budgets, constraints, and conflict policy are explicit.

gate_plan.name: Story Intention Gate
acceptance: Core question, emotional anchor, core conflict, gameplay expression, ending philosophy, and character intention roles are explicit.
blockers: Characters do not map to the intention.

gate_plan.name: Story Graph Plan
acceptance: Node graph, branch types, value system, route matrix, witnesses, and media hooks are explicit.
No pseudo choices, orphan failures, or ending-by-last-choice-only structure remain.
blockers: Facts needed by choices have no earlier delivery path.

conflict_policy.agent_change_limits: Agents may propose cross-discipline changes but must not silently edit another discipline's source of truth.
